title: Sardar
desc: Son of a disgraced spy, Inspector Vijay Prakash must race against the clock to stop a mysterious water company from producing and spreading toxic water across the nation.

title: Ganeshana Galate
desc: Burdened by his wife's endless demands, Ganesh's despair leads him to attempt suicide. Unbeknownst to him, a bounty hunter is on the prowl for him.

title: Moggina Manasu
desc: Renu, Akka, Didi and Chanchala are four friends from college who face several adversities in life. However, they find one way or another to live their life to the fullest.

title: Hatamari Hennu Kiladi Gandu
desc: Stuck in a loveless marriage, an arrogant woman suspects her husband of infidelity and humiliates his alleged mistress.

title: Anuraga Aralithu
desc: Shankar, a factory worker, is forced to marry his employer's daughter who is arrogant. He decides to teach her a lesson in order to make her realize her fault.
